marketing_description: The DeWALT DCN930B Framing Nailer offers cordless convenience, allowing users to save time in setup and clean-up. This tool features a brushless motor and innovative flywheel that stays active for 6 seconds after the trigger is released, and its lightweight design removes the need for hoses and compressors. With this nailer, users can install up to 530 sqft of subflooring per charge and complete up to 100 ft. of wall framing per charge.
